svg.text: Use labelled jumper wires to each breakout. Hole names such as A3 are breadboard coordinates, never Pi header positions.
V.A.M.P. | Default robot/config.json | Module drawings use pin LABELS, not physical footprints.
Use rows 1-30 of a standard board. A-E are joined across each row; F-J are joined separately.
The centre trench isolates the two halves. Rail strips run vertically; bridge any midpoint split in each strip.
Join GND rails only - keep 3V3 and +5V separate
Pi 3V3 -> left 3V3 rail; Pi GND -> left GND rail.
BEC +5V -> right +5V rail; BEC GND -> right GND rail.
Pi GPIO2 -> A3; GPIO3 -> A5; GPIO26 -> F24 (divider node).
Only sensor supply current uses these rails; Pi/servo/motors use sheet 1.
Each separate hole in a rail takes one wire. Check rail continuity first.
VCC -> 3V3 rail; GND + A0 + A1 + A2 -> GND rail.
SDA -> E3; SCL -> E5; RESET / RST -> E15.
R3: A15 to A18. Jumper E18 to 3V3 rail. RST is held HIGH.
R3 can be omitted if the carrier already has its own 3V3 reset pull-up.
Channels 2-7 stay unused. GPIO2/3 drive the upstream bus only.
SDA -> E7; SCL -> E9. INT / XDA / XCL unused.
Keep the IMU still for its startup gyro calibration.
VCC -> 3V3; GND -> GND; SDA -> E11; SCL -> E13.
Place away from the MQ-2 heater; measure ambient air.
VCC -> +5V rail; GND -> GND rail; D0 / DO -> F20.
R1 10k: J20 to J24. R2 15k: H24 to H28.
J28 -> GND rail; F24 -> Pi GPIO26. A0 / AO unused.
Check the node voltage with GPIO26 disconnected: valid HIGH, <= 3.3 V.
Ideal 5 V HIGH becomes 3.0 V at NODE.
Carrier pull-ups can reduce HIGH further; measure it.
A3 / E3 etc. refer ONLY to this breadboard. Breakouts stay beside it; wire by their printed pin labels.
GPIO3 is the clock, NOT the 3V3 supply. Never connect raw MQ-2 D0, +5V or VM to a Pi signal GPIO.
If a downstream I2C branch lacks pull-ups: add 4.7k from its SDA to 3V3 and from its SCL to 3V3.
This is a proposed layout for your default map. Follow config.local.json if you already changed GPIO assignments.
3V3 / +5V / VM are different positive nets. All GND nets share one reference. Never feed raw 3S to DRV8833 VM.
